verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents deploying apps in regions worldwide, with users routed to the nearest server over a global Anycast network, and Machines that 'run close to your users'. That gives edge-proximate serving of whatever the app serves, including static files. However, nothing in the evidence describes a CDN, edge caching layer, cache-control handling, or a dedicated static-asset service. Missing for 10: an edge caching or CDN feature, static asset serving and caching documentation, and independent corroboration of asset delivery performance.
